# NOUGHTS AND CROSSES - M.K. Dowson - DREAMER 14 p.13 (PDF page 15) - CHIP-8 0090-03F5, run C000
# Two players (O & X). Keys 0,1,2 / 4,5,6 / 8,9,A = the nine squares (keypad layout).
# Games restart automatically, the loser of the last game... (alternate player to the last winner)
# goes first; cumulative scores are kept (reset by a restart from C000).
# Load: the 0090-00F7 part (subroutines + 16-row "wins" sprite at 00E6) and 0200-03F5.
# Note: the printed listing is a memory dump taken after play: the low bytes of 4A21 at
# 0280/0284/0290/0294/02A0 (key tests) and 027E 6021 are workspace; 0240-0266 rewrites the key
# values at the start of every game, so they are transcribed as printed.
